title: Research Assistant in Single-Cell Transcriptomics
description: Requirements: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Molecular Biology or Genetics. Hands-on experience with RNA isolation, qPCR, and library preparation for NGS. Basic R or Python skills. Fluent English.

title: Bioinformatics Intern - Structural Biology & Docking
description: Requirements: Student in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or related. Knowledge of molecular docking (AutoDock, Vina), protein structure visualization (PyMOL, Discovery Studio), and Python.

title: Laboratory Technician - Protein Expression & Western Blot
description: Requirements: Technical training (BTA/MTA) or B.Sc. in Biology. Routine Western blotting, BCA assays, SDS-PAGE, and cell counting. English required, German advantageous.

title: Clinical Trials Safety Officer
description: Requirements: Medical Doctor (MD) or Pharm.D. degree with 5+ years of pharmacovigilance experience in EU safety reporting. Fluent German mandatory (C1).

title: Full Stack React / Node.js Web Developer
description: Requirements: 4+ years of TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js microservices. No biology background needed.

title: Computational Cancer Biologist - TCGA & Immune Profiling
description: Requirements: Degree in Bioinformatics. Experience analyzing bulk and single-cell RNA-seq from public repositories (TCGA, GEO). Differential expression, survival analysis in R.

title: Research Intern - Cardiovascular Prevention
description: Requirements: Background in Molecular Medicine or Biology. Immunofluorescence staining, qPCR, shRNA knockdown in cell models. English proficiency.

title: Lead SAP ERP Financial Consultant
description: Requirements: 7+ years SAP S/4HANA financial accounting experience. German C2 required.

title: Junior Data Scientist - Multi-Omics & Python
description: Requirements: Degree in Bioinformatics, Data Science or Computational Biology. Python, Pandas, machine learning, and biological dataset handling.

title: Animal Facility Manager (Veterinarian)
description: Requirements: Licensed veterinarian with FELASA C certification and 5+ years of rodent breeding management.
